_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Shemot 20, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: Then God spoke to them all of this discourse, saying:
translations.2: I am God your Lord, who brought you out from the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
translations.3: You shall have no other object of worship besides Me.
translations.4: You shall not make for yourself a graven image nor a likeness — of what is in the sky in the heights, or of what is in the earth in the depths, or of what is in the water beneath the earth.
translations.5: You shall not bow down to them nor worship them — for I am God your Lord, the Able, the Punisher, who demands the sins of the fathers together with the sons, and the third and the fourth generation, for those who hate Me;
translations.6: and who does good to thousands, among those who love Me and keep My commandments.
translations.7: You shall not swear by the name of God your Lord falsely — for God will not acquit one who swears by His name falsely.
translations.8: Remember the day of the Sabbath and sanctify it.
translations.9: Six days you shall labor and do all your crafts.
translations.10: But the seventh day is a Sabbath to God your Lord — you shall do nothing of the crafts: you, and your son and your daughter, your male servant and your maidservant and your beasts, and your guest who is in your place.
translations.11: For God created in six days the sky and the earth, and the sea and all that is in them, and gave them rest on the seventh day — therefore God bestowed His blessing upon the day of the Sabbath and sanctified it.
translations.12: Honor your father and your mother, so that your span of days may be long in the land which God your Lord is giving you.
translations.13: You shall not kill a person. You shall not commit adultery. You shall not steal. You shall not bear false witness against your fellow.
translations.14: You shall not covet the house of your fellow; you shall not covet his wife, nor his male servant and his maidservant and his ox and his donkey, and all that is his.
translations.15: And all the people were beholding the thunderclaps and the bolts of fire, and the sound of the horn, and the mountain enveloped in smoke; and when they saw this, they were terrified, and they stood at a distance.
translations.16: And they said to Moses: 'Speak to us yourself — we will hear from you; but let not God speak to us, lest we perish.'
translations.17: And Moses said to the people: 'Do not fear — for it is in order to test you that the light of God appeared to you, and in order that His awe may be in your hearts, that you should not sin.'
translations.18: And the people stood at a distance, while Moses drew near to the thick cloud where the light of God was.
translations.19: And God said to Moses: 'Thus say to the sons of Israel: You have witnessed that from the heavens I addressed you.'
translations.20: 'You shall not make alongside Me objects of worship of silver, nor objects of worship of gold — you shall not make them for yourselves.'
translations.21: 'An altar of earth you shall make for Me, and sacrifice upon it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings — from your flock and your cattle — in every place where I cause My name to be remembered; I will appear to you and bestow My blessing upon you.'
translations.22: 'And if you make for Me an altar of stones, you shall not build them hewn — for if you move your iron tool upon them, you have degraded them.'
translations.23: 'And you shall not ascend by steps upon My altar, so that your nakedness not be uncovered upon it.'
